get.description:
This API endpoint lets you retrieve the Ocrolus <<glossary:Book>> associated with a specific Encompass loan. You can query it using either the `Encompass loan_id` (GUID) or the `loan_number`, depending on which identifier you have available. 

> 📘 Note:
> The system accepts either `loan_id` or `loan_number` to identify the loan. If both parameters are provided, or if neither is included in the request payload, the API returns a 400 error.

parameters.name: loan_id
parameters.description: The unique Encompass loan identifier expressed in Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) format.

parameters.name: loan_number
parameters.description: The numeric identifier assigned to an Encompass loan.

status.description: A numerical code that indicates the status of the request.

response.description: An object received from the server that potentially contains data.

loan_number.description: The loan number associated with the request.

book_details.description: Details of the book associated with the loan.

created_ts.description: Timestamp when the book was created.

message.description: A message describing the result of the request.

value.message: Exactly one of loan_id or loan_number must be provided

status.description: A numerical code that indicates the status of the request.

message.description: A textual description that indicates details about this response's status.

get.description: This API retrieves the Encompass Loan GUID and related loan metadata using the Ocrolus <<glossary:Book>> UUID. It enables seamless mapping between an Ocrolus Book and its corresponding Encompass Loan, supporting accurate LOS integration, tracking, and synchronization between Ocrolus and Encompass systems.

parameters.name: book_uuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the <<glossary:Book>> from which you want to retrieve loan details. Mutually exclusive with `book_pk`.

status.description: A numerical code that indicates the status of the request.

response.description: An object received from the server that potentially contains data.

loan_details.description: Details of the loan associated with the request.

loan_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the Encompass loan GUID.

created_ts.description: Timestamp when the loan was created.

book_details.description: Details of the Book associated with the loan.

created_ts.description: Timestamp when the Book was created.

book_uuid.description: A unique identifier of the Book.

message.description: A message describing the result of the request.

get.description:
Retrieve a list of all <<glossary:Book>>s available to the current user.

---

> 📘
> - By default results are ordered by <<glossary:Book>> PK in descending order but you can alter how and what books are returned by providing different parameters with your request.
> - Use the `name` query parameter to find a <<glossary:Book>> by an exact name. This will be faster than `search` which uses approximate string matching algorithm.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Sets the number of results to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Sets the starting point of the results list. The list is index-based and starts at integer 0.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: By default, results are returned in descending order, which is newest to oldest.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Determines what field to order the results by.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter books by keyword search on book_name

status.description: A numerical code that indicates the status of the request.

created.description: The date and time when the <<glossary:Book>> was created.

created_ts.description: The timestamp at which <<glossary:Book>> was created.

pk.description: Unique identifier key (primary key) of the <<glossary:Book>>.

owner_email.description: The email address of the <<glossary:Book>> owner.

is_public.description: Indicates if the <<glossary:Book>> is public or not.

book_uuid.description: A universally unique identification code (uuid) of the <<glossary:Book>>.

xid.description: A free form field that can be used to associate a Book with some identity outside of Ocrolus.

book_type.description: Determines what type of processing the Book will go through. Options include DEFAULT, OPTIMA, or WIDGET.

message.description: A textual description that indicates details about this response's status.

get.description:
Retrieve the status of a <<glossary:Book>>.

---
This endpoint can also be used to keep track of the status of the Documents within the <<glossary:Book>>.

For more information about the various processing statuses of a <<glossary:Book>> during its life cycle, visit our guide on [Book Statuses](doc:book-status-code).

Similarly, if you are interested in knowing more about the different stages of Document processing, visit our guide on [Document Statuses](doc:document-status).
